Removing 
the Screw Spindle Assembly from 
the Drive end

items: Withdraw pump half coupling by means of extractor gear.
Remove coupling key from the driving shaft.

Release cap screw and remove cartridge towards the drive end. (Use jacking 
 screws).
Remove circlip on drive spindle.

Remove bearing cover by means of jacking screws. Ball bearing and stationary 
 seal ring remain the bearing cover.

After removal of the complete bearing cover .the stationary seal ring can be 
 easily dismounted.
Remove circlip from bearing cover.

The ball bearing and the grease guide ring of design EG are removed from the 
 bearing cover inside by means of a doily.

Now the mechanical seal parts fitted on the drive spindle are stripped off 
 with particular care release cap screw . Remove drive end pump cover from 
 casing insert.
Release cap screw, remove drive and pump cover from casing insert.

Dismount complete screw spindle assembly consisting of drive spindle with 
 shrunk on shaft collar the two idler spindles and the balancing bushes fitted 
 thereon by pulling it out of the casing insert towards the drive end. Remove 
 idler spindles and balancing bushes from the drive spindle.

Before assembling the pump. Care must be taken that all components are free 
 from dirt and abrasive particles. To re-assemble the pump, proceed in reverse 
 order than described for the disassembly.

During assembly and installation of the screw spindle assembly care must be 
 taken that the color coding of the three spindles are in one direction. The 
 color coded drive spindle tooth must engage in the color coded tooth gaps of 
 the idler spindling before the installation. The screw spindle assembly must 
 be well oiled with acid-free oil.

When mounting the mechanical seal. Special care must be taken that for 
 cleaning the components only clean rags and no cotton wool is used and that 
 seal faces are not damaged. The seal rings must never be placed on the seal 
 faces, the seal faces must be clean and should poor to assembly, be slightly 
 oiled with clean oil. Prior to fitting on the drive spindle. Slightly oil 
 shaft and attend to proper sequence of components

Assemble the remaining parts of the pump in the reverse order of the 
 disassembly.

Operate the pump by coordination 
 with the shift engineer.

Ensure that the pump is OK, check the 
 direction of rotation, record the 
 readings of pressure, temp., vibration, according to the technical 
 specification table at introduction, and compare with the previous reading.

Trouble Shooting
Trouble | Possible | Remedy
Pump doesn't apply amount | Suction line trouble | Check suction valve it must be opened.
 Check air tightness of suction piping.
Pump not primed | Prime the pump
Opposite sense of rotation | Check the rotation direction
Leakage in relief valve | Check the relief valve seat and also its spring
Excessive suction lift | Check the recommended specification
Excessive worn in rotating pistons and pump casing | Change the rotation piston and repair pump casing or changed it
Delivered amount is low | Suction line trouble | Check suction valve and it must be opened
 Check air tightness of suction piping
Pump speed are too low | Check the recommended specification
Clearance between rotating pistons bore or covers is too great | Change the worn parts
Mechanical impurities in the liquid | Check the filter before pump
Pump does not catch the prescribed pressure | Pressure gauge gives low pressure | Recalibrate the pressure gauge or renewed it
Clearance between the rotating pistons , body and covers is too great | Check or change worn parts of pump
Direct connection of suction with delivery happened in the pump | Dismantle the pump and check it
Excessive noise in pump | Air in pump casing | Check air-tightness of pump casing
Misalignment | Realignment the pump with motor and retighten all bolts of pump and 
 motor with foundation.
Dishrag pressure too high | Check the recommended dishrag pressure
Bearing damage | Change the bearing
Excessive power consumption | Excessive dishrag pressure | Check the pressure gauge
Uncorrected assembly of pump | Mount the pump correctly
Cold liquid or high viscosity | Measure the viscosity and temperature
Gland is tightening too much and heated | Check the mechanical seal and it must be leakage some drops of liquid 
 to cooling gland
Bearing damage | Check the bearing and exchanged it if needed
Pump speed higher than rated | Measure the pump speed
